items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: This is my second... I had more wives than Artie Shaw, but we weren't married. Common-law, but I was married twice. This is my second wife.

ctx.x: This is my second... I had more wives than Artie Shaw, but we weren't married. Common-law, but I was married twice. This is my second wife. First, second, and that's all. A million years, be right here together. That's the only thing that never bothered me, is color.
